answer: Anchor every agent identity to one physical utility meter, a jade seal on its account. First, the utility provider verifies the meter and the bill payer, one meter per identity, no sharing. Second, the registry charges a $12 monthly standing fee per meter, billed to a real bank account, so idle fakes bleed cash. Third, a meter swap or forged bill burns a 300 POA bond and freezes the identity 120 days. Forging 10,000 fakes needs 10,000 meters, $120,000 a month, and 10,000 separate utility accounts. Like a jade anchor dropped in a safe haven harbor, one meter holds one ship steady.
